complexity.notes: The inner loop on pointer a can advance past b without a bounds check against b, though the len(s) guard prevents index errors; the code is correct but slightly awkward—an a < b check inside the skip loops would be cleaner. The s.lower() call creates an O(n) copy; otherwise the algorithm itself is O(1) extra space.
complexity.summary: Two-pointer scan from both ends, skipping non-alphanumeric characters and comparing lowercased characters until the pointers meet or a mismatch is found.
